summary: The tournament field is now the lobby the host built (humans + placed AI, captured at the fresh start as MaelstromDataSO.FieldSize, capped at SeatCount) instead of always 4. Padding to 4 with balanced AI turned every lobby into Jade/Ruby/Gold/Ruby or Jade/Ruby/Ruby/Jade (the Ruby-first tie-break), overriding the teams the host made.
